answer: Each of 362 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A exam certificate with testing body attestation works as the gate: a certificate number in the testing body system. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The lotus record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the zephyr entry is checkable by anyone, and the jetty window closes before a farm can catch up.
